english.note: Use this specifically when an insect or object flies while making a buzzing sound.

examples.english: A bee can buzz as it flies by my ear, and it really annoys me.
examples.traditional: 隻蜜蜂喺我耳仔邊嗡住飛，搞到我好煩。
